Hot Honey Garlic Chicken Tacos 🌮 Crispy, sticky, cheesy, loaded with creamy jalapeño ranch Ingredients For the Chicken: 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into small pieces 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp chili powder ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper For the Sticky Hot Honey Garlic Sauce: ½ cup honey 2 tbsp hot sauce 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp butter 1 tbsp soy sauce ½ tsp red pepper flakes For the Creamy Jalapeño Ranch: ½ cup ranch dressing 1 small jalapeño, finely chopped 1 tbsp lime juice 2 tbsp chopped cilantro For the Tacos: 8 small flour tortillas 1½ cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese 1 cup shredded lettuce or cabbage ½ cup diced tomatoes ¼ cup diced red onion Fresh cilantro Lime wedges Instructions 1. Season and Cook the Chicken Toss chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden and cooked through to 165°F. 2. Make the Sticky Sauce Lower the heat slightly. Add butter and garlic to the skillet and cook for 20–30 seconds. Stir in honey, hot sauce, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes. Let it bubble for 1–2 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Toss the chicken until every piece is coated. 3. Mix the Jalapeño Ranch Stir together ranch, jalapeño, lime juice, and cilantro. Keep it slightly thick so the drizzle looks dramatic. 4. Crisp the Tacos Add a little Monterey Jack cheese to one side of each tortilla, top with hot honey chicken, fold, and toast in a clean skillet for 1–2 minutes per side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish Open each taco slightly and add shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and red onion. Drizzle generously with creamy jalapeño ranch and finish with cilantro and a squeeze of lime. #tiktokfood #EasyRecipe #tiktokcreatorsearchinsightsincentive #comfortfood #DinnerIdeas

Ingredients 1 tbsp olive oil 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced (or ground beef if preferred) 1 onion, sliced 1 green bell pepper, sliced (optional but traditional) 3 cloves garlic, minced 2 cups beef broth 1 cup milk 8 oz uncooked penne pasta 4 oz cream cheese, softened 1 cup shredded provolone (or mozzarella/cheddar blend) Salt and pepper, to taste Optional garnish: chopped parsley Instructions 1. Cook the steak: Heat olive oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add the sliced steak, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned. Remove from the pot and set aside. 2. Sauté the vegetables: In the same pot, add the sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for about 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 3. Add liquids and pasta: Pour in the beef broth and milk. Bring to a boil, then stir in the uncooked pasta. Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and simmer for about 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked and most of the liquid is absorbed. 4. Make it creamy: Reduce the heat to low. Stir in the cream cheese until completely melted and smooth. 5. Combine everything: Add the cooked steak back to the pot. Stir in the shredded provolone cheese and mix well until everything is coated in a creamy, cheesy sauce. 6. Taste and serve: Adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve hot and garnish with chopped parsley if desired. #easydinnerideas #comfortfood #EasyRecipe #tiktokfood #beef

Creamy, smoky, cheesy and just spicy enough. This Cajun potato soup is loaded with tender potatoes, smoked sausage, crispy bacon and plenty of Cajun flavor. Perfect when you want something cozy with a little kick. 🔥 Recipe Ingredients * 1 lb smoked sausage, sliced * 6 slices bacon, chopped * 2 lbs Yukon Gold or russet potatoes, diced * 1 small onion, diced * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 4 cups chicken broth * 1½–2 tbsp Cajun seasoning * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ¼ tsp cayenne pepper, or more to taste * 1 cup heavy cream * 1½ cups shredded cheddar cheese * 2 tbsp butter * Salt and pepper to taste * Green onions for topping Directions 1. Cook bacon in a large pot until crispy. Remove and set aside, leaving a little bacon grease behind. 2. Add sausage and brown for 3–4 minutes. Remove and set aside. 3. Add butter and onion to the pot. Cook until softened, then stir in garlic. 4. Add potatoes, chicken broth, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika and cayenne. 5. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer about 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are fork tender. 6. Lightly mash some of the potatoes right in the pot to thicken the soup. 7. Stir in heavy cream, cheddar cheese and sausage. Simmer on low until creamy and heated through. 8. Taste and adjust seasoning. 9. Top with crispy bacon, extra cheddar, green onions and a little Cajun seasoning. Tip: For an extra kick, add a few dashes of hot sauce before serving. 🌶️ #CajunRecipes #PotatoSoup #EasyDinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #SoupSeason

Ingredients: 1 lb smoked sausage, sliced into rounds 1 tbsp olive oil 1 small onion, diced 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 package (20 oz) cheese tortellini 2 cups heavy cream 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 2 tbsp cream cheese Salt and black pepper, to taste Fresh parsley, for garnish Directions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sausage and cook until browned. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, cook the onion until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add the Cajun seasoning and smoked paprika, stirring to coat the onions. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Stir in the cream cheese until completely melted and smooth. Add the Parmesan cheese and mix until the sauce is creamy. Return the sausage to the skillet and add the tortellini. Stir well to coat everything in the sauce. Cover and cook for 5–7 minutes, until the tortellini is tender. Stir in half of the mozzarella cheese until melted, then sprinkle the rest over the top. Cover for another 2 minutes until the cheese melts, then garnish with parsley and serve. Cooking Time: 35 minutes Servings: 5 Calories: 690 per serving
